item.content:encoded:
Otaku Oneiroi

Oh… I never really intended this to have anything to do with the Oneiroi. The setting (in a crackfic, Ha!) is a subset of lolFoundation-verse, but the reality bender that started it being a Japanese ani-manga otaku-type. Said otaku unleashed his full potential when he remains a virgin at age 30 (thanks to some weird Japanese rumour), and warps the world around him.

… But sure, it could just be the guy's dream. I will not dispute it at all. It can be both at the same time.

item.title: AF2016 Entry, Attributions, and Other Matters
item.content:encoded:
For the record, if I get to choose the title, it would have been "Fanservice Galore". And word count is: 1372. Link to fanfic.net counterpart: https://www.fanfiction.net/s/11874633/1/

And the link in the "disclaimer" is my tribute to Love Live, who had recently concluded their last "one-man Live" on 1 April. May their songs be heard.

This is my entry for the 2016 crackfic contest, where I am supposed to write "SCP the Anime, part 4".

SCPs mentioned are:

  • SCP-140 (An Incomplete Chronicle) by AssertiveRoland
  • SCP-239 (The Witch Child) by Danteson
  • SCP-336 (Lilith) by Dr Kondraki
  • SCP-408 (Illusory Butterflies) by Dr. Kondraki
+ show block
– hide block

Characters featured are:

  • O5 members
  • Dr. Judith Low
  • Dr. Rights
  • Dr. Light
  • Dr. Kain
  • Dr. Bright
  • Dr. Clef
  • D.C. al Fine
  • Dr. Kondraki
  • Bumaro
  • Grand Karcist Ion
  • Marshall Carter (& Dark the rifle)
  • Nobody's voice
  • Dr. Gears
  • Dr. Iceberg
  • MrWrong

First scene of part 1 is based on Akira, especially Neo-Site-19. Also cue random generic yandere scene.
Part 2 is an "adaptation" of Clef-Kondraki saga and Fate Stay Night.1
Part 3 is an adaptation of the Japanese folktale Momotaro.
Part 4 is just a clip show.

And yes, I am really busy and should not be writing articles… but damn, crackfics in this site is once in a lifetime and those kind of stuff are likely to be among the first things we read about the Foundation.
